narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Suli Trilingual Press"**

The site is a two-colour proof sheet pulled in a Sulaymaniyah print shop that sets every line in three scripts. Light mode is bright white stock; dark mode is the navy-black printing plate itself. There are only two inks, the logo's navy and orange, and every surface is either stock, a tint of stock, or a solid plate of ink. Separation happens with full four-sided frames, ornament rows and space, never with hairline rules or single-edge accents.

Density is calm and phone-first: big type in the page language, then the same claim proofed in the other two scripts at small size, then the real team and a way to call. The world refuses the IT-category default (blue gradient, laptop hero, icon-card grid) and equally refuses the vintage-newspaper costume: no distressed textures, no column rules, no fake mastheads with dates and prices.

Kurdish (Sorani, `ckb`) is the default language and is RTL, as is Arabic; English is LTR. The theme is Auto by default and follows the system, with explicit Light and Dark overrides.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks only (navy, orange) on white stock or a navy-black plate.
Every container is a closed four-sided frame (2px) with a 4px corner.
Registration marks and the logo-derived cube ornament are the only decoration.
Each script gets its own type pair and its own line height; Arabic-script text is never letter-spaced.
Real photography only, printed as navy-and-orange duotones inside framed plates.
Flat: the one blurred shadow in the system belongs to the floating menu.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Only navy and orange are inks. Any new colour must be a tint of the stock, a shade of one ink, or an overprint of the two. No third hue, no gradients.

rules.name: The Stock And Plate Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is not an inversion. White stock becomes the navy-black plate; frames lighten; the primary button changes ink from navy to orange (`ink-orange` on `navy-ink`) and the focus ring turns orange. Both token sets are defined three times: `:root` for light, `prefers-color-scheme: dark` guarded by `:root:not([data-theme="light"])` for Auto, and `:root[data-theme="dark"]` for the explicit override.

rules.name: The Orange Carries No Text On White Rule
rules.body: On white stock, orange text and icons use `orange-text`; raw `ink-orange` is a fill, a mark or an underline only.

rules.name: The Script Owns Its Metrics Rule
rules.body: On `:lang(ckb)` and `:lang(ar)` the font tokens swap to Noto Kufi Arabic + Vazirmatn, body line height rises to 1.85, heading line height to 1.45, and letter-spacing is 0 everywhere. Negative tracking (`-0.025em`) is a Latin display device only.

rules.name: The Each Line In Its Own Script Rule
rules.body: When one surface sets text from several languages (edition strip, proof sheet, proof strip, language switch), each run carries its own `lang` and `dir` and picks its script's face. Brand and personal names are set in Archivo, `dir="ltr"`, `translate="no"`.

rules.name: The Mirror Only What Points Rule
rules.body: In RTL, only directional glyphs flip (`scale: -1 1` on the link arrow and anything marked as flippable); logos, the cube ornament, registration marks, photos and the phone glyph do not.

rules.name: The Native Digits Rule
rules.body: Kurdish and Arabic pages render numerals in Eastern Arabic digits (facts, phone number, copyright year); English uses Western digits. Phone numbers are always wrapped in `<bdo dir="ltr">` so the digit groups never reorder.

rules.name: The Printed Not Lit Rule
rules.body: No other blurred drop shadows. If something needs to stand forward, put it on a plate of ink or inside a frame.

rules.name: The Overprint Rule
rules.body: Team and training photos are navy/orange duotones on a light paper plate with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`, so the ink prints into the paper in both themes. The founder portrait is not multiplied: it is a cut-out duotone standing in front of a solid orange disc inside its framed plate.

rules.name: The Four Sides Rule
rules.body: A border is all four sides or none. No single-edge borders, no accent stripes, no column rules, no underline bars under headings.

dos: Do close every container with a 2px frame on all four sides and a 4px corner.
Do keep to two inks: navy `#0c3f68` and orange `#f7941e`, on white stock or the navy-black plate.
Do define every colour token for light, Auto-dark and explicit dark, and keep Auto as the default theme.
Do set Kurdish and Arabic in Noto Kufi Arabic + Vazirmatn with line height 1.85 and no letter-spacing.
Do write layout in logical properties and mirror only directional arrows in RTL.
Do render digits as Eastern Arabic in ckb/ar and wrap every phone number in `<bdo dir="ltr">`.
Do print photos as duotones in framed plates, with multiply overprint on team and training plates but not on the founder portrait.
Do separate sections with tinted bands, ornament rows and space.
Do label every fact and source every claim from real company information.
donts: Don't use one-sided borders, accent stripes, column rules or heading underline bars.
Don't use blurred drop shadows anywhere except the floating menu popover.
Don't use stock photos; only the real team, founder and training room.
Don't build icon-disc cards or icon-card grids.
Don't put eyebrows or kickers above headings.
Don't fabricate proof: no invented testimonials, client logos, ratings or numbers.
Don't add a third hue or a gradient.
Don't letter-space or uppercase Arabic-script text.
